syncs.description: Make recording metadata available as records, including stable recording identifiers and available titles, Weflow links, and participants. Recording media and derived content remain separate on-demand resources.
syncs.name: sync-recordings

id.description: Opaque identifier of this Weflow recording, usable by recording-specific tools.

url.description: Weflow application page URL for the recording when supplied; not a media URL.

title.description: Recording title when supplied; omitted when unavailable, with empty text retained.

participants.description: Reported recording participants when supplied; omitted if unavailable, distinct from a known empty array.

email.description: Participant email address as reported when supplied, without inferred identity matching.

items.description: A reported recording participant.

Recordings.description: Recording metadata, excluding recording media and derived content.

syncs.description: Make available summary templates accessible as records with selection identifiers and available human-readable names and descriptions.
syncs.name: sync-summary-templates

id.description: Opaque identifier of the summary template, usable as summaryTemplateId for recording summary retrieval.

name.description: Human-readable template name when supplied; omitted when unavailable.

description.description: Provider description of the template's purpose when supplied; omitted when unavailable, with empty text retained.

SummaryTemplates.description: Summary templates available for selecting recording summary formats.

functions.name: get-recording
functions.description: Get metadata for one recording by its identifier, including available title, application link, and participants.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording, returned by list-recordings.

FunctionInput_weflow_getrecording.description: Identifier of the recording whose metadata to retrieve.

url.description: Weflow application link for this recording when supplied; not a media URL.

title.description: Recording title when supplied; omitted when unavailable.

participants.description: Participants reported for the recording; omitted if unavailable, distinct from a known empty list.

email.description: Participant email address as reported when supplied; no inferred identity matching is performed.

items.description: A participant reported for this recording, without transcript speaker matching.

FunctionOutput_weflow_getrecording.description: Recording metadata without media bytes, transcript content, or inferred participant identities.

tags.instructions: Obtain recordingId from `list-recordings`. Use this for recording metadata, not media bytes or transcript content. Use `get-recording-transcript`, `get-recording-summary`, or `get-recording-video-urls` for those tasks.

functions.name: get-recording-interaction-metrics
functions.description: Get available interaction metrics for a recording, retaining metric names, values, and any supplied units or participant context.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording whose interaction metrics to retrieve.

FunctionInput_weflow_getrecordinginterac.description: Recording whose interaction metrics to retrieve.

name.description: Provider metric name or unambiguous source path when a nested scalar metric is flattened.

unit.description: Explicit provider unit or scale label, if supplied; omitted when unknown. No implied conversion to percentages or durations.

value.description: Metric value in the provider's supplied scale and precision; null represents an explicitly unavailable measurement.

participantId.description: Opaque provider participant or speaker identifier when this is a participant-specific metric; omitted for unscoped metrics.

items.description: One provider measurement with any available unit and participant identifier.

metrics.description: Available metrics, retaining provider labels and scales rather than inventing universal metric definitions.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording described by these metrics.

FunctionOutput_weflow_getrecordingintera.description: Interaction measurements for the requested recording, without scale conversion.

tags.instructions: Obtain recordingId from `list-recordings`. Use this for measured interaction data; use `list-recording-scorecards` for evaluations and `get-recording-transcript` for spoken content. Do not assume a unit or scoring range when it is absent from the result.

functions.name: get-recording-summary
functions.description: Get the summary of a recording for a caller-selected summary template, with readable content and any supplied section structure.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording to summarize.

summaryTemplateId.description: Opaque identifier of the summary template selected from list-summary-templates.

FunctionInput_weflow_getrecordingsummary.description: The recording and explicitly selected summary template to read.

text.description: Readable summary content, preserving Unicode and supplied markup. Structured sections are rendered in provider order when no complete text is supplied.

sections.description: Summary sections when the provider supplies structure; omitted for an unstructured summary.

text.description: Readable content of this section, retaining Unicode, line breaks, and supplied markup.

title.description: Section heading when supplied; omitted when untitled.

items.description: An ordered summary section with readable content and an optional heading.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording whose summary was read.

summaryTemplateId.description: Opaque identifier of the template used for this summary.

FunctionOutput_weflow_getrecordingsummar.description: The selected recording summary as readable text and any supplied section structure.

tags.instructions: Get recordingId from `list-recordings` and summaryTemplateId from `list-summary-templates`. Select the template that matches the user's desired summary. This reads a summary; it does not promise to generate or regenerate one. Use `get-recording-transcript` for the spoken content.

functions.name: get-recording-transcript
functions.description: Get a recording's readable transcript and any supplied speaker-attributed segments.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording whose transcript to retrieve.

FunctionInput_weflow_getrecordingtranscr.description: Recording whose available transcript to retrieve.

text.description: Readable transcript text retaining Unicode and line breaks; if no complete text is supplied, segment text is joined in provider order with newlines.

segments.description: Provider-supplied transcript segments in provider order; omitted for an unsegmented transcript.

text.description: Readable spoken content for this segment, with no transport encoding.

speakerId.description: Opaque speaker identifier when supplied; not assumed to match a participant ID or email.

endSeconds.description: Segment end offset in seconds from the beginning of the recording, preserving supported fractional precision; omitted if unavailable.

speakerName.description: Speaker display name when explicitly supplied; omitted otherwise.

startSeconds.description: Segment start offset in seconds from the beginning of the recording, preserving supported fractional precision; omitted if unavailable.

items.description: One provider-supplied transcript segment.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the transcribed recording.

FunctionOutput_weflow_getrecordingtransc.description: Readable recording transcript and any supplied speaker-attributed segments.

tags.instructions: Get recordingId from `list-recordings`. Use this for spoken content, or `get-recording-summary` for a template-based summary. Segment offsets are relative seconds, not calendar timestamps. This reads an available transcript and does not promise to start transcription.

functions.name: get-recording-video-urls
functions.description: Get the provider-supplied video URLs for a recording without downloading the media.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording whose video URLs to retrieve.

FunctionInput_weflow_getrecordingvideour.description: Recording whose provider-supplied video links to retrieve.

url.description: Provider-supplied video URL, preserving its path, query, signature, and escaping exactly.

label.description: Explicit provider label or source field name distinguishing this URL; omitted when none is supplied.

items.description: One provider-supplied video link and its explicit source distinction, when present.

urls.description: Video links returned by Weflow, with no implied permanence, anonymous access, or guaranteed download semantics.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording associated with these video URLs.

FunctionOutput_weflow_getrecordingvideou.description: Requested recording identifier and unchanged provider-supplied video URLs.

tags.instructions: Use recordingId from `list-recordings` to obtain video URLs. This returns links, not video bytes, and does not guarantee that links are permanent or anonymously accessible. Use `list-recording-clips` for links to individual clips. Request fresh URLs if previously returned ones no longer work.

functions.name: list-recording-clips
functions.description: List one page of clips associated with a recording, including available titles, links, and clip boundaries.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from this tool for the same recording and connection; omit initially.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording whose clips to list.

FunctionInput_weflow_listrecordingclips.description: Identify the recording and optionally continue a previous clips page.

id.description: Opaque clip identifier when supplied by Weflow.

url.description: Provider-supplied link for the clip; omitted when unavailable, with no inferred permanence.

title.description: Clip title when supplied; omitted if unavailable.

endSeconds.description: Clip end offset in seconds from the start of the recording, including provider-supported fractional precision; omitted when unavailable.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the parent recording.

startSeconds.description: Clip start offset in seconds from the start of the recording, including provider-supported fractional precision; omitted when unavailable.

items.description: A clip associated with the requested recording.
Clips in this provider page, preserving provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for another page; omitted at confirmed exhaustion.

FunctionOutput_weflow_listrecordingclips.description: One provider page of recording clips and any available continuation.

tags.instructions: Get recordingId from `list-recordings`. Use this to discover clips of that recording; use `get-recording-video-urls` for the full recording's video URLs. Continue with nextCursor as cursor for the same recording when returned.

functions.name: list-recording-comments
functions.description: List one page of comments on a recording with readable comment content and available author and reply context.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this tool for the same recording and connection; omit for the first page.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording whose comments to list.

FunctionInput_weflow_listrecordingcommen.description: The recording whose comments to read and an optional continuation.

text.description: Decoded comment content as ordinary text, retaining supplied markup and Unicode rather than stripping content.

authorName.description: Comment author's display name when supplied; omitted when unavailable.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the parent recording.

parentCommentId.description: Opaque parent comment identifier for a reply when supplied; omitted when no parent is reported.

items.description: A recording comment with available identity, author, and explicit reply context.
Comments in this provider page, in provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token; omitted when exhaustion is established.

FunctionOutput_weflow_listrecordingcomme.description: One provider collection of recording comments and any continuation.

tags.instructions: Use a recordingId from `list-recordings` to read its comments. This does not create or reply to comments. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same recordingId to continue when returned.

functions.name: list-recording-scorecards
functions.description: List one page of scorecards for a recording, including available scores and criterion-level evaluations without assuming a universal scoring scale.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from this tool for the same recording and connection; omit initially.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording whose scorecards to list.

FunctionInput_weflow_listrecordingscorec.description: Select the recording whose scorecards to read.

score.description: Overall score in its supplied scale or label; explicit null means no overall score was provided, while omission means the field is absent.

criteria.description: Criterion-level evaluations when supplied; omitted if unavailable and empty if explicitly none.

score.description: Criterion score or label in the provider's scale, preserving explicit null and numeric precision.

feedback.description: Readable criterion feedback when supplied, retaining Unicode and markup.

items.description: One criterion evaluation in its supplied scale.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the evaluated recording.

items.description: One cached scorecard evaluation for the requested recording.
Scorecards in one provider page, preserving provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token; omitted when the collection is confirmed exhausted.

FunctionOutput_weflow_listrecordingscore.description: One page of recording scorecards, retaining supplied score scales and criterion feedback.

tags.instructions: Use recordingId from `list-recordings`. Use this for scorecard evaluations, or `get-recording-interaction-metrics` for interaction measurements. Continue with nextCursor as cursor for the same recording when supplied. Scores retain their provider scale.

functions.name: list-recording-trackers
functions.description: List one page of tracker results associated with a recording, including available labels and matched content.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this tool for the same recording and connection; omit initially.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording whose tracker results to list.

FunctionInput_weflow_listrecordingtracke.description: Select the recording whose tracker results to retrieve.

name.description: Tracker label when supplied, with provider meaning preserved.

matches.description: Matched occurrences when explicitly supplied; omitted if unavailable and empty for an explicit empty list.

text.description: Matched text or readable occurrence content from the provider, retaining Unicode and markup.

startSeconds.description: Occurrence start offset in seconds from the beginning of the recording when supplied with interpretable units; omitted otherwise.

items.description: One matched occurrence supplied by Weflow.

trackerId.description: Opaque identifier of the tracker definition when supplied; not assumed to identify a unique occurrence.

recordingId.description: Opaque identifier of the recording containing these tracker results.

items.description: A tracker and its available matches for the requested recording.
Tracker results in this provider page, in provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for the next page; omitted at confirmed exhaustion.

FunctionOutput_weflow_listrecordingtrack.description: One provider page of tracker results for the recording.

tags.instructions: Get recordingId from `list-recordings`. Use this to inspect tracker results for that recording, not to configure trackers. Use `get-recording-transcript` for the complete spoken content. Continue with nextCursor as cursor for the same recording when returned.

functions.name: list-recordings
functions.description: List one page of recordings accessible to the connection, with identifiers and available metadata.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from list-recordings for the same connection. Omit for the first page.

FunctionInput_weflow_listrecordings.description: Parameters for browsing one page of recordings accessible to this connection.

id.description: Opaque recording identifier used by the recording-specific tools.

url.description: Link to the recording in Weflow when supplied; not a video download URL.

title.description: Recording title when supplied; an empty title remains empty, and an unavailable title is omitted.

items.description: A recording identifier and the available listing metadata.
Recordings in this provider page, in provider order; empty when this page has no recordings.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token for the next page; omitted when the provider indicates there are no more results.

FunctionOutput_weflow_listrecordings.description: One page of recordings and an optional continuation token.

tags.instructions: Use this to discover recording IDs. Use `get-recording` for metadata about a known recording, and the recording-specific tools for its transcript, summary, or other content. Pass nextCursor back as cursor to continue when it is returned. Each call returns one page, not the entire recording library.

functions.name: list-summary-templates
functions.description: List one page of available summary templates so callers can select a template for a recording summary.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from list-summary-templates for the same connection; omit initially.

FunctionInput_weflow_listsummarytemplate.description: Options for listing one page of available summary templates.

id.description: Opaque summary template identifier accepted as summaryTemplateId by get-recording-summary.

name.description: Human-readable template name when supplied; omitted when unavailable.

description.description: Provider description of the template's purpose when supplied; omitted when unavailable.

items.description: An available summary template that can be selected for a recording summary.
Summary templates in this provider page, preserving provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for the next page; omitted at confirmed exhaustion.

FunctionOutput_weflow_listsummarytemplat.description: One provider page of summary templates and continuation when available.

tags.instructions: Use this before `get-recording-summary` to choose summaryTemplateId. Select by the available name and description rather than assuming the first template is a default. Pass nextCursor back as cursor to continue when returned.
